geometry_edits.rationale: Recast the dominant mass as a more legible bent bar, preserving the existing primary volume while improving continuity.
Increase the bend to sharpen the dominant gesture and reduce the box-like read.
Refine the bend with more segments for smoother form continuity.
Introduce a public courtyard/void that preserves the bent mass ancestry while creating a legible ground threshold.
Size the void to be functionally public rather than a thin notch.
Orient the courtyard opening to the verified access side.
Make the new courtyard-conditioned mass the root so the public void governs the compiled solid.

graph_edits.rationale: Strengthen the dominant bent-bar gesture so the mass reads less like a generic box and more like a clear continuous spatial rule.
Increase continuity of the bent mass and reduce the blocky, over-rectangular perception.
Add a real carved void tied to the existing primary courtyard so the public threshold becomes legible at the ground and the access edge can read as an entry court/void rather than a sealed face.
Keep the void substantial enough to function as usable public space, not just decorative subtraction.
Align the void opening with the programmed access side so the building clearly addresses the verified frontage.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent mass in all four views, so it clears basic geometric coherence and repair integrity. However, it is too box-like and only weakly responsive to the neighborhood-living semantic contract. The major problem is the ground condition: the blue access edge is not answered by a clear public threshold, undercut, or legible entry court, so the form feels sealed or semantically sideways to the site access. The visible mass also lacks a convincing section/program relationship for a compact mixed-use neighborhood building; the roof/upper mass is calm but generic, and the courtyard/terrace intent is not made spatially public enough. Reference resonance comes mainly from the prism and courtyard references, but the candidate underperforms those precedents in public void clarity and edge activation.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much taller and more tower-like than this low-rise neighborhood-living brief; copy the clarity of mass hierarchy, not the vertical typology.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Clear prism-to-taper massing with a legible public-ground relationship and mixed-use tower logic.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Courtyard-facing, inward/outward thresholding that creates a usable semi-public outdoor room.
